Note: the “idx” input represents a matrix of index information for the sparsity of A.
Note: the “idx” input itself is not dense, only part of it is used. The part in each VGPR that is used is specified by CBSZ and ABID
Note: The A matrix is packed 4:2 and hence has effectively half the K size, also called KP
Note: We interpret the “index matrix” as having 2bit elements / items. Each element describes the true coordinates for a single packed coordinate
